descricao: Muffled radio pop songs can be heard playing in the main area, and the DJ station at the south side of the rink can occasionally be seen having a docile Faceling sitting inside selecting songs. Other sounds, such as skates hitting the rink's wooden floor and laughter, can be heard. The scent of cheap pizza and soda pop radiates from the direction facing the food court. Entry 1 Arrival When I arrived, all I could remember was the wooden door within the brick walls of a long-forgotten electrical station. Familiar music came through the barrier, something I've heard back home.
